title: egg spoons
text: egg spoons. These are good... just thin...was hoping for a bit more sturdy spoon.  The bowls are bit sharp because they are thin.  Some may find that good for scooping the egg yolk out or whatever you're using them for.  They are just not as heavy as I would like.  Stainless steel and they have washed up in the dishwasher nicely.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Endurance Egg Spoons Stainless Steel Set of 4
description: These European designed Egg Spoons fit perfectly inside a soft boiled egg with out damaging the shell. The 4 spoon set is made entirely of 18/10 Stainless Steel and would go perfectly with our many different varieties of egg cups.
